event: WSK Final Cup — Round 1, Franciacorta (26–30 Aug 2026)
result: Won the Final by a margin of over two seconds
whyItMattered: Perico qualified and raced through the heats no better than 5th all weekend, then put together a Final that FIA Karting's own report called a total dominance — checking out from the field and winning by more than two seconds. That kind of jump between heat pace and final-day execution, rather than leading a weekend wire-to-wire, is exactly the sign scouts and teams look for.
